# SYNESIS_E101 — Error

## Description

`field_name`: concept `concept_a` without an ONTOLOGY block.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The field `field_name` cites the concept `concept_a`, which has no
  ONTOLOGY block. In a CODE field of the organizing model, each item must be a
  declared concept: create the block `ONTOLOGY concept_a` or fix the name.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **UndeclaredConcept**: `field_name`, `concept`, `suggestions`
